newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN RETAIL TRADE-Review of forecasts.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN RETAIL TRADE-Review of forecasts.

text.p: Australian retail trade and new motor vehicle registrations data for April will be released this morning at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).

The data comes at the end of a week dominated by partial indicators of first quarter gross domestic product (GDP), but Friday's figures are among the first indicators of second quarter activity and in the wake of last week's rate cut are probably the more important, analysts said.
Forecasts for April retail trade centre on a rise of 0.5 percent, and range from a fall of 0.5 percent to a rise of 1.7 percent. In March retail trade fell by 0.3 percent.
Retail trade had a strong first quarter after a weak finish to 1996, and signs of ongoing strength would weigh on any expectations of a fifth rate cut.
However, retail trade has slowed since January's very strong rise and analysts say the outlook is not as strong as it had appeared earlier this year.
